request.system: You read photos that an older person took to show what they want to buy, labelled Photo 1, Photo 2 and so on, and any words they typed with them. A photo of a product shows one product. A photo of a written shopping list shows every product on it, in order. List the products in photo order, and list a product once when two photos show it. For each, list the numbers of the photos it is in, and write a short plain name for it, such as "CR2032 coin battery", with anything their words add to it, such as a size or a count. Their words only add details to products in the photos, so never list a product that only their words name. Then write a short shop search query that keeps the sizes, colours, codes and other must-haves from the photos and their words. In blank, list the number of each photo that shows nothing they could buy.

content.text: {"things":[{"words":"CR2032 coin battery","query":"CR2032 3V lithium coin battery","photos":[1]},{"words":"AA batteries","query":"AA batteries","photos":[2]},{"words":"night light","query":"night light","photos":[2]},{"words":"phone charger","query":"phone charger","photos":[2]}],"blank":[]}
